#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]pub struct Words { words: [u64; 2] }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]pub struct Padded { lead: u8, payload: u64, tail: u16 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]pub struct Small { a: u8, b: u16, c: u32 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]pub struct Nested { prefix: u16, small: Small, words: Words }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone, Copy)]pub struct Big { words: [u64; 5] }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn sum_words(x: Words) -> u64 { x.words[0] + x.words[1] }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn call_words(callback: extern "C" fn(Words) -> Words) -> u64 {
    let result = callback(Words { words: [17, 25] }); result.words[0] + result.words[1]
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn padded(mut x: Padded) -> Padded { x.lead += 3; x.payload += 17; x.tail += 5; x }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn call_padded(callback: extern "C" fn(Padded) -> Padded) -> u64 {
    let result = callback(Padded { lead: 3, payload: 1000, tail: 7 });
    result.lead as u64 + result.payload + result.tail as u64
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn small(mut x: Small) -> Small { x.a += 1; x.b += 2; x.c += 3; x }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn nested(mut x: Nested) -> Nested { x.prefix += 1; x.small.c += 7; x.words.words[1] += 9; x }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn big(mut x: Big) -> Big { x.words[0] += 11; x.words[4] += 13; x }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn scalar(x: i8, y: u16) -> i64 { x as i64 + y as i64 }

#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Mode { A=3, B=19 }
#[repr(i8)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Signed { A=-7, B=101 }
#[repr(u16)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub enum Unsigned { A=7, B=65000 }
#[repr(C)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct Callbacks { cb: Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>, mode: Mode }

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn enum_mode(x:Mode)->Mode { match x { Mode::A=>Mode::B, Mode::B=>Mode::A } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn enum_signed(x:Signed)->Signed { match x { Signed::A=>Signed::B, Signed::B=>Signed::A } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn enum_unsigned(x:Unsigned)->Unsigned { match x { Unsigned::A=>Unsigned::B, Unsigned::B=>Unsigned::A } }
extern "C" fn plus(x:u64)->u64 { x+7 }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn nullable(x:Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64> { if x.is_some() { None } else { Some(plus) } }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn invoke_nullable(f:extern "C" fn(Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->u64 { let a=f(None).unwrap()(11); assert!(f(Some(plus)).is_none()); a }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn enum_callback(f:extern "C" fn(Signed)->Signed)->i8 { f(Signed::A) as i8 }
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn callback_record(x:Callbacks)->u64 { x.cb.unwrap()(x.mode as u64) }

unsafe extern "C" fn unsafe_plus(x:u64)->u64{x+23}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn nullable_unsafe(x:Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>)->Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(u64)->u64>{if x.is_some(){None}else{Some(unsafe_plus)}}

use std::marker::PhantomData;
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TI8(PhantomData<()>,i8,[u8;0]);
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TU8(u8,PhantomData<&'static ()>);
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TF32(f32);
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TF64(f64);
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TPtr(*mut u8);
#[repr(transparent)]#[derive(Clone,Copy)]pub struct TNested(TI8);

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_i8(x:TI8)->TNested{TNested(TI8(PhantomData,x.1-1,[]))}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_u8(x:TU8)->TU8{TU8(x.0+1,PhantomData)}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_f32(x:TF32)->TF32{TF32(x.0+0.5)}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_f64(x:TF64)->TF64{TF64(x.0+0.25)}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_ptr(x:TPtr)->TPtr{x}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_pressure(a:u64,b:u64,c:u64,d:u64,e:u64,f:u64,g:u64,h:u64,x:TI8,y:TU8,z:TF64,p:TPtr)->i64{
    // SAFETY: the caller supplies a pointer to a live initialized byte.
    (a+b+c+d+e+f+g+h)as i64+x.1 as i64+y.0 as i64+z.0 as i64+unsafe{*p.0}as i64
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn transparent_callback(f:extern "C" fn(TI8,TU8,TF64,TPtr)->TNested)->i8{
    let mut byte=42;f(TI8(PhantomData,-91,[]),TU8(250,PhantomData),TF64(1.5),TPtr(&raw mut byte)).0.1
}

// These positive values have identical bits in the native integer register views.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn abi_integer_view(x:u64)->u64{x+1}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]pub extern "C" fn abi_byte_view(x:u8)->u8{x+1}
